blocks.text: LAPU-LAPU CITY — A 21-year-old student will be facing theft charges after he was caught allegedly stealing P10,000 from the house of a vlogger on Monday night in Sitio Datag, Barangay Daanlungsod, Alcoy town in southern Cebu. The student, who worked for vlogger Ronnie Suan, who is also known as “Boy Tapang,” was detained at the Alcoy Police Station detention cell after his arrest. Investigation showed that the vlogger’s house helper chanced upon the first-year college student clambering over the rail of the balcony of the vlogger’s room.
